structured.answer: Seems like I should open a securities account (חשבון ניירות ערך) and put the money in a fund that tracks the S&P 500, and also check the קרן השתלמות I already have from work and maybe a קופת גמל להשקעה. I'm fairly sure, because the "two parts" idea (where it's kept / what it's in) clicked for me.

stuck.why: The heading promises "חשבון בבנק, קופה או חשבון השקעות", but this card describes a short loan to the state, not an account
Again a loan to the state sitting in the 'where the money is kept' section, where it should be accounts
Same item appears in both sections, so I couldn't tell which list it really belongs to and started doubting the sorting
I thought it was a pension thing, but the card says you can withdraw any time; not sure if it's for me

used: Cards קרן השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה
skimmed: קרן כספית / קרן כספית מתחדשת cards
skipped: אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה / לא צמודה cards
Small line "בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה..."
not_found: Fees in shekels or any fee comparison
A clear 'first step' recommendation for someone with ~30,000 ₪
How to actually open a securities account / which bank or house

findings.what: Section promising accounts ("חשבון בבנק, קופה או חשבון השקעות") includes "מק"מ", which its own card describes as a loan to the state, not an account
"איגרות חוב ממשלתיות" (a loan to the state) listed under 'where the money is kept' among accounts and funds
"מק"מ" appears in both the 'where kept' and 'what invested in' lists, which made me doubt the whole split
No recommendation or 'start here' for someone with spare cash; "מאיפה להתחיל" only covers employees, pension and short-term cash
Lots of look-alike cards (about 9 index cards), hard to choose between
Jargon in card text (צמודה, מנוטרלת, חשיפה לדולר) with no explanation
